description: This Java class 'PeriodicAccrualAccountingHelper' facilitates triggering periodic accrual accounting processes via REST API calls within integration tests for Apache Fineract. It contains methods to generate request payloads and send POST requests to run accruals, with deprecated notes indicating a plan to transition to a newer client library.

classes.name: PeriodicAccrualAccountingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing periodic accrual accounting via REST API in integration tests.

methods.name: runPeriodicAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Triggers the run of periodic accruals for a given date by sending a POST request to the Fineract API.

methods.name: getRunPeriodicAccrual
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the accrual run request with the specified date.
